events_voting_order.name: events_voting_order
events_voting_order.value: "events"."voting_open_at" is null or "events"."voting_close_at" is null or julianday("events"."voting_open_at") < julianday("events"."voting_close_at")

voters_kind_identity.name: voters_kind_identity
voters_kind_identity.value: ("voters"."kind" = 'account' and "voters"."user_id" is not null) or ("voters"."kind" = 'listed' and "voters"."email" is not null and "voters"."token_hash" is not null) or ("voters"."kind" = 'link' and "voters"."token_hash" is not null)
